imp.state.awake.note: State of an Imp that can think.

imp.state.asleep.note: State of an Imp that has no Brain or cannot reach it.

imp.state.waking.note: State of an Imp being checked after a Brain was chosen.

imp.state.out.note: State of an Imp let out of the window.

imp.state.visiting.note: State of an Imp whose home is another device.

imp.state.away.note: State of an Imp that went to visit another device.

imp.phone.label.note: Tooltip and screen reader label of the small phone icon after an Imp's name.

imp.out.undo.note: Undo bar after an Imp is let out.

imp.home.undo.note: Undo bar after a free Imp is sent home into the window.

imp.hide.undo.note: Undo bar after an Imp is hidden.

imp.sent.undo.note: Undo bar after an Imp was sent to another device.

imp.transfer.failed.note: Message when an Imp could not go to another device.
imp.transfer.failed.en: {device} did not take {name}. It stays here.
imp.transfer.failed.es: {device} no aceptó a {name}. Se queda aquí.

imp.drag.hint.note: Screen reader hint on an Imp.

imp.drag.out_hint.note: Screen reader hint on an Imp on desktop.
imp.drag.out_hint.en: Drag it out of the window to let it out.
imp.drag.out_hint.es: Arrástralo fuera de la ventana para dejarlo salir.
imp.drag.out_hint.zh-Hans: 把它拖出窗口，就能放它出来。

imp.let_out.unavailable.note: Shown instead of Let out on desktops that cannot place windows (Wayland).
imp.let_out.unavailable.en: This desktop does not let apps place free windows, so Imps stay in the window.
imp.let_out.unavailable.es: Este escritorio no deja que las apps coloquen ventanas libres, así que los Imps se quedan en la ventana.
imp.let_out.unavailable.zh-Hans: 这个桌面不允许应用自由摆放窗口，所以 Imp 会留在窗口里。

imp.a11y.call_home.note: Screen reader action for an Imp away on another device.

imp.call_home.title.note: Asks before taking back an Imp from the device that holds it.

imp.call_home.message.en: It comes back here now, even if {device} is gone for good. If {device} connects again, it learns the Imp left.
imp.call_home.message.es: Vuelve aquí ahora, aunque {device} ya no esté. Si {device} se conecta de nuevo, sabrá que el Imp se fue.
imp.call_home.message.zh-Hans: 它现在就回到这里，即使 {device} 再也不会出现。如果 {device} 再次连接，它会知道 Imp 已经离开。

imp.call_home.other_device.note: Stands for the device holding an Imp when its name is not known (it was never linked).

imp.a11y.label.note: Screen reader label of an Imp: its name and its state.
